title: Nageki no Kenkou Yuuryouji
justification: TVDB 128501 is gone and no TVDB series or movie carries this 1994 three-volume OVA: TheTVDB search finds nothing for Frantic, Frustrated & Female, F3 or Nageki no Kenkou Yuuryouji, nor does SkyHook, and the franchise has no other anime. AniList 316 marks it adult, so the marker is hentai. TMDB 43350 season 1 holds the three episodes (all 1994-08-05), so the TMDB values stay.
